su-tpia-1370399466.d:
Chandra Asri Group is a leading chemical and infrastructure solutions company in Indonesia with a track record of over 31 years in the petrochemical industry. The company employs over 2,000 dedicated staff, incorporates state-of-the art technologies and supporting facilities located strategically in the country’s industrial hub, Cilegon and Serang. As a Growth Partner, Chandra Asri is committed on creating high-value jobs, expanding the domestic petrochemical value chain, and serving the needs of the vibrant and growing Indonesian market. Chandra Asri is currently expanding its portfolio in the energy sector and incorporating its asset as well as operational infrastructure to supports the expansion plan of the second world-scale integrated petrochemical complex in Indonesia, CAP2.

Job Description :

• Carry out all routine/non-routine maintenance work related to mechanical rotating equipment, includes regular maintenance patrol, evaluate and take necessary action to fix any mechanical problem or follow up problem found in the previous shift.
• Implement the mechanical field activity to follow the work instruction and procedure correctly to increase productivity and keep production process smoothly.
• Check and identify mechanical rotating equipment problems to specify root cause to achieve equipment rectification correctly.
• Implement safe working practices and good housekeeping at the activity of mechanical maintenance team in accordance the safety and health, environment and Quality Management systems.
• Ensure proper waste handling as an impact of those above activities and make an effort in compliance with relevant environmental law and regulation.
• Directly responsible with a shift contractor who assist him to perform his shift job.
• Ensure clear written and oral communication among operation, other shift team and contractor during performing his job. Record and report immediately any abnormality to the related section/Department during his duty.
• Real commitment towards OHS Management and its implementation, participate in OHS related key activities/ programs within the company.

Requirements :

• Diploma Degree (D3) majoring in mechanical engineering
• Minimum 3 years working experience as mechanical technician/maintenance, especially for rotating equipment
• Highly motivated and eager to learn
• Service oriented
• Has strong basic knowledge of mechanical engineering
• Team-work oriented.

This position will be placed at Site Office Cilegon

IMPORTANT NOTES :

Chandra Asri is only releasing official job posting at Chandra Asri Career Site (careers.capcx.com), Linkedin & Jobstreet. The Company will contact shortlisted candidate via official corporate email & phone, and will not send any hardcopy invitation for interview. Please note that the Company doesn’t ask candidates to transfer some amount of money nor cooperate with any travel agent.

wo-klbf-JR26_000248.d:
Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

Requirements:

• Memiliki kemampuan analisis yang kuat serta mampu menginterpretasikan dan menerjemahkan kebutuhan pengguna menjadi solusi yang dapat diimplementasikan
• Berpengalaman dalam dokumentasi kebutuhan pengguna serta memastikan kejelasan kebutuhan bisnis
• Memiliki pemahaman terkait operasional shared services, khususnya di lingkungan HR Shared Services
• Memahami proses dan praktik Human Resources (HR) dengan baik
• Memiliki pengalaman langsung dalam penggunaan Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS)
• Pengalaman menggunakan sistem HRIS Workday menjadi nilai tambah
• Memiliki minimal 5–6 tahun pengalaman kerja yang relevan
• Latar belakang sebagai konsultan HRIS diperbolehkan, dengan pengalaman terbukti dalam implementasi atau operasional HRIS
• Memiliki kemampuan manajemen proyek yang sangat baik serta mampu mendorong pencapaian target
• Berpengalaman dalam administrasi data HR dan analisis data operasional
• Memiliki exposure atau pengalaman dalam inisiatif digital HRGA

Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab:

1. Manajemen Sistem HRIS Workday

· Mengelola dan memastikan sistem berjalan dengan optimal.

· Melakukan pembaruan dan pemeliharaan sistem secara berkala.

· Memastikan integrasi yang efektif antara HRIS dan sistem lain yang terkait (absensi, payroll, e-sertifikat, technical competency, dll).

· Mengelola database HRIS yang lama di server agar tetap dapat diakses.

2. Pengelolaan laporan dan Analisa HRIS Workday

· Berkoordinasi dengan HR perusahaan untuk memperbarui database karyawan agar lengkap dan akurat.

· Membuat format laporan di sistem yang akan digunakan untuk kebutuhan analisa dari masing-masing bagian untuk mendukung pengambilan keputusan strategis HR.

· Membuat dan memberikan masukan atas report dari SLA antara HR Shared Services dan unit bisnis yang terkait sistem (misal: job change, termination, data completeness, respon time tiket, penyelesaian case tiket).

3. Dukungan Proses HR di HRIS Workday

· Menangani masalah teknis dan memberikan dukungan penggunaan sistem untuk proses HRD

· Memberikan bantuan dalam pelatihan kepada HR dan karyawan terkait penggunaan.

· Melakukan pengaturan role, permission, dan pengamanan sistem sesuai kebijakan organisasi.

· Memfasilitasi HR dengan tim IT dalam pengembangan aplikasi diluar HRIS di Group untuk URS (user requirement specification) dan development sampai dengan penentuan project owner dan leader

Company:
KF PT. Kalbe Farma Tbk.
